name: Kaburagi Shougen
source:
A hospital staff member who lectures and advises the protagonist on his job, "washing corpses."
He is a professional corpse cleaner who always performs his job calmly and diligently.

[Translated from the [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20080916134717/http://www.silkys.jp/game/shitai/chara/kaburagi.html]official website, archived[/url]]
